description: Defines interfaces and classes for controlling a Radio Unit (RU), including operation, gain, carrier frequency offset, center frequency, and transmit time offset controls.

classes.name: ru_operation_controller
classes.description: Interface for starting and stopping the Radio Unit operation.

classes.name: ru_gain_controller
classes.description: Interface for modifying transmission and reception gain of the Radio Unit.

classes.name: cfo_compensation_request
classes.description: Structure for setting Carrier Frequency Offset (CFO) with optional timestamp.

classes.name: ru_cfo_controller
classes.description: Interface for setting downlink and uplink carrier frequency offsets.

classes.name: ru_center_frequency_controller
classes.description: Interface for setting downlink and uplink carrier center frequencies.

classes.name: ru_tx_time_offset_controller
classes.description: Interface for setting transmit time offset.

classes.name: ru_controller
classes.description: Main interface for controlling the Radio Unit, providing access to various control interfaces.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the Radio Unit operation, blocking until fully started.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the Radio Unit operation, blocking until fully stopped.

methods.name: set_tx_gain
methods.description: Sets transmission gain for a specified port.

methods.name: set_rx_gain
methods.description: Sets receive gain for a specified port.

methods.name: set_tx_cfo
methods.description: Sets downlink carrier frequency offset for a sector.

methods.name: set_rx_cfo
methods.description: Sets uplink carrier frequency offset for a sector.

methods.name: set_tx_center_frequency
methods.description: Sets downlink carrier center frequency for a sector.

methods.name: set_rx_center_frequency
methods.description: Sets uplink carrier center frequency for a sector.

methods.name: set_tx_time_offset
methods.description: Sets transmit time offset for a sector.

methods.name: get_operation_controller
methods.description: Returns the operation controller of the Radio Unit.

methods.name: get_gain_controller
methods.description: Returns the gain controller or nullptr if unsupported.

methods.name: get_cfo_controller
methods.description: Returns the CFO controller or nullptr if unsupported.

methods.name: get_center_frequency_controller
methods.description: Returns the center frequency controller or nullptr if unsupported.

methods.name: get_tx_time_offset_controller
methods.description: Returns the transmit time offset controller or nullptr if unsupported.
